scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,mobile -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @codex-mobile/server" "npm run dev -w @codex-mobile/mobile"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @codex-mobile/protocol && npm run build -w @codex-mobile/mobile && npm run build -w @codex-mobile/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @codex-mobile/server && npm run test -w @codex-mobile/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @codex-mobile/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @codex-mobile/server && npm run typecheck -w @codex-mobile/mobile
scripts.host:start: npm run build -w @codex-mobile/protocol && npm run build -w @codex-mobile/server && node --env-file=.env apps/server/dist/index.js
